Linux RIFE flow exports and TensorRT cache builders now coordinate per content key. Concurrent consumers wait and reuse the completed artifact instead of repeating the same build. Failed builders release the key; closing an asynchronous context cancels its lock wait. Fast motion exports are coordinated too.

Short real-builder checks reduced duplicate flow stagings and TensorRT builders from two to one. Same-plan outputs remained exact; failure, cancellation and corrupt-cache repair passed. This reduces duplicate build work; no steady-state FPS gain is claimed.

Other native formats/platform qualification, abrupt-stop recovery and disk/quota handling remain separate work. See [the qualification report](https://github.com/Ta2b/mpv-AnimeJaNai-HDR/blob/release/docs/qualification/lot-10-key-locks-20261016.md). Platform assets appear independently as builds complete.
